verdict.rationale: Self-hosting the sync server is a fair question for a password manager, but nothing in the evidence shows 1Password lets you run its sync backend on your own infrastructure. Connect Servers are an adjacent feature: they give your apps API access to items and vaults, not a replacement for the sync service. Community comments also note the loss of local vault storage, which points away from secrets staying entirely inside your perimeter.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can self-host the sync server on my own infrastructure and keep every secret inside my perimeter
